title: DashboardFilterDescriptor
description: Static filter applied to a dashboard visualization or KPI item.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use dashboard filters to constrain the data behind a visualization, for example only active records or only records above a threshold. Each condition property must exist on the visualization/item entity. Combine conditions with `operator: "and"` or `operator: "or"`. `isNull`, `isNotNull`, and relative-date filter types such as `thisMonth` do not need a `value`.

stableId.description: Optional stable identifier assigned by the designer so model history and mutations can address this condition. Omit in hand-written descriptors; the runtime generates one when missing.

property.description: Property name to filter on. Must exist on the visualization/item entityName.

filterType.description: Comparison applied to the property. Prefer lower-camel-case values; PascalCase aliases are accepted for compatibility.

value.description: Filter value, stored as a string in descriptor JSON. Shape depends on filterType and target property type; omit for isNull/isNotNull and relative-date filter types.
